title: The Lampstand
lead: The seven-branched gold lampstand (menorah) stood in the tabernacle and temple (Exodus 25:31–40). Zechariah sees a lampstand fed by two olive trees (Zechariah 4), Jesus calls his followers the light of the world (Matthew 5:14–16), and in Revelation seven lampstands are seven churches (Revelation 1:20). The menorah became the oldest symbol of the Jewish people.
